column1: # ACTION JF (agents limb), p170. penecho/penecho at HEAD 076c1ad54a85 -- UNCHANGED since p169, so
# every difference below is INSTRUMENT, not tree. p169 recorded "4 root + 32 below". p170 reproduces
# 4 + 32 EXACTLY under a broad name match (any path containing licen|copying|notice, case-insensitive).
# A CANONICAL-FILENAME regex (^LICENSE$|^COPYING$|^NOTICE$|*.LICENSE) finds only 15 of the 36 --
# it under-reads by 21, i.e. 58%, because these grants live in names like katex-LICENSE,
# distinct_families counts licence FAMILIES whose body is present in that one file.
# TALLY over the 32 non-root files: 21 MIT-only, 5 Apache-2.0, 1 ISC, 3 carrying TWO families,
# 2 carrying no body at all (third-party NOTICE manifests, tables not grants).
# gap 111's EPL-2.0 is CONFIRMED and LOCATED: architecture-LICENSES.txt and workflow-LICENSES.txt,
# BYTE-IDENTICAL (blob 286f4fcb048f), both bundling Archify 2.17 + "ELK / elkjs 0.12.0" -- so p169's
# attribution of the EPL-2.0 to elkjs HOLDS, read off the artifact at line 25.
# Those bundles also carry EPL-2.0's Exhibit A naming GPL-3.0-or-later as a SECONDARY licence. The
# Exhibit is the unfilled FORM, and the file itself says "Simply including a copy of this Agreement,
# including this Exhibit A is not sufficient to license the Source Code under Secondary Licenses."
# So the secondary licence is NOT elected here. Recorded because a scanner keying on the string
# "GNU General Public License v3.0 or later" will report a GPL-3.0 dependency that does not exist.
# The one GPL body: ink-lab-LICENSE.txt, a 3-package bundle (Nerdamer 1.1.13, PptxGenJS 4.0.0,
# JSZip 3.10.1). JSZip is DUAL "MIT or GPLv3" by its own words, so the GPL-3.0 body is an OPTION
# the redistributor declines by electing MIT. No GPL obligation enters penecho from it.
# DEDUP: the 32 paths hold only 26 DISTINCT blobs. three-LICENSE appears 3x (blob 8ada2a5f9829),
# and 4 further blobs appear twice. "36 grant surfaces" counts PATHS, not grants.
